required_pinned_source.completed_result_applied: Theorem C ruled one-sheet estimate applied to R=2HY+2HZ+2YZ: p_R(t)<=pi*sqrt(2) for t<=0 after negation. Theorem H also applied to a two-hub diffuse-star family.

partner.result_applied: QFORM-ANYPIVOT-RANKONE-SHAREDHUB-TENSOR-L1-v1: ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3*2^(2/3) T^(-1/6) for rank-one interbank crossing with arbitrary hub pivot and same-bank phases.

new_results.statement: For independent density-capped X,Y, W=cXY+dY+R(X) obeys ||p_W||_2^2<=4FG/|c| for arbitrary measurable R.
Two genuinely source-disjoint one-sided-curvature hyperbolic pairs have bounded density by L2 convolution; for cap-one 2alpha XY and 2sigma UV the bound is 2/sqrt(|alpha sigma|).
For independent H,Y,Z,U,V, Q=aH^2+2alpha HY+2beta HZ+2delta YZ+bU^2+2sigma UV+affine has continuous C0 density <=2/sqrt(|alpha sigma|), and <=2/sqrt(|sigma|max(|alpha|,|beta|)) when beta!=0.

rank_two_log_control: For centered unit uniforms p_{2XY}(t)=log(1/(2|t|)) on 0<|t|<1/2. The new mechanism does not bound that rank-two density; it uses its L2 integrability. For the exact-rank-three triangle R=2HY+2HZ+2YZ, the Schur complement of the physical pair (H,Y) is -2 Z^2, and the completed pair-log theorem gives ||p_R||_infinity<=8sqrt(5).
operator_obstruction: A naive full-rank extension of partner r44's pointwise tensor operator can lose its shared-hub |t|^-1 gain: after shearing, kernel k_t(y+z)e^{i2t delta yz}; choosing an allowed hub square a=1/delta cancels the Fresnel phase and leaves an L2 operator multiplier of order |t delta|^-1/2. This obstructs that proof interface, not QFORM.
first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-R44-RANK2-CROSSING-SAMEBANK-INTERPOLATION-v1: extend the L2 hyperbolic-pair gain to same-product-bank projected pairs with arbitrary same-bank curvature uniformly as the second crossing singular value tends to zero, or force a source-disjoint physical-pair/volume/square exit; arbitrary additional nonseparable spectrum remains a separate bridge.
